nodes.title: Baroque chiaroscuro
nodes.essence: Faces and hands pulled out of near-black by one hard beam of light.

nodes.title: Dutch Golden Age interior
nodes.essence: Cool daylight from a side window across tiles, plaster and one expensive blue.

nodes.title: Rococo
nodes.essence: Powder pastels, gilt curls and pink skies: the court at play.

nodes.title: Romantic sublime
nodes.essence: Tiny figures, vast weather: storms, fog and burning skies that dwarf people.

nodes.title: Pre-Raphaelite
nodes.essence: Jewel-bright greens, copper hair and botanical detail painted leaf by leaf.

nodes.title: Victorian parlour
nodes.essence: Heavy plum, bottle green and oxblood rooms, gaslit and patterned edge to edge.

nodes.title: Impressionism
nodes.essence: Broken strokes of clean color that shimmer into light when you step back.

nodes.title: Pointillism
nodes.essence: Dots of pure color placed side by side, meant to blend in the eye at a distance.

nodes.title: Tonalism
nodes.essence: One veil of mist over everything: a whole picture in a single close key.

nodes.title: Art Nouveau
nodes.essence: Whiplash curves, peacocks and lilies in sage, mustard and dusty plum.

nodes.title: Vienna Secession gold
nodes.essence: Flat gold leaf, mosaic spirals and pale faces floating in pattern.

nodes.title: Fauvism
nodes.essence: Colors straight from the tube: green faces, red trees, orange seas.

nodes.title: Expressionism
nodes.essence: Jagged forms and colors chosen for feeling: blue horses, yellow skies, acid greens.

nodes.title: De Stijl
nodes.essence: Primary red, yellow and blue in black grids on white. Nothing else.

nodes.title: Constructivism
nodes.essence: Red wedges, black type and cream paper: art built like a machine for the revolution.

nodes.title: Bauhaus
nodes.essence: Circle, square, triangle in primaries, plus steel, glass and plain white walls.

nodes.title: Art Deco
nodes.essence: Black lacquer, gold sunbursts and jade: luxury in sharp geometry.

nodes.title: Streamline Moderne
nodes.essence: Rounded corners, speed lines and cream stucco: everything shaped like a fast train.

nodes.title: Mid-century modern
nodes.essence: Teak, mustard and teal, with low furniture and walls of glass onto a garden.

nodes.title: Space Age
nodes.essence: White plastic pods, silver vinyl and bright orange: home as a spaceship.

nodes.title: Pop art
nodes.essence: Comic-strip primaries, Ben-Day dots and supermarket brightness.

nodes.title: 1960s psychedelia
nodes.essence: Vibrating opposites, melting letters and swirling orange, magenta and acid green.

nodes.title: Swiss Style
nodes.essence: Grid, sans-serif and one red: information made clean.

nodes.title: Brutalism
nodes.essence: Raw concrete under a grey sky, softened only by moss and orange tiles.

nodes.title: 1970s earth tones
nodes.essence: Harvest gold, avocado and burnt orange on shag and dark wood.

nodes.title: 1980s neon
nodes.essence: Hot pink, electric blue and lime on black, or on Miami pastels.

nodes.title: Postmodern architecture
nodes.essence: Classical columns in salmon, mint and terracotta: architecture with a wink.

nodes.title: Memphis
nodes.essence: Squiggles, terrazzo and clashing pastel-and-primary laminates.

nodes.title: Corporate Memphis
nodes.essence: Flat cartoon people with long limbs in purple-blue skin, in tech company illustrations.

nodes.title: Grunge
nodes.essence: Flannel, faded black and thrift-store olive under a grey Seattle sky.

nodes.title: Ukiyo-e
nodes.essence: Flat woodblock color, indigo and Prussian blue seas, pale skin and vermilion.

nodes.title: Wabi-sabi
nodes.essence: Worn, uneven, earthy: crackled clay, moss and the beauty of age.

nodes.title: Japandi
nodes.essence: Pale oak, oatmeal linen and charcoal clay: Scandinavian calm meets Japanese restraint.

nodes.title: Scandinavian minimalism
nodes.essence: White walls, pale wood, grey wool and one green plant against the long dark.

nodes.title: Hygge
nodes.essence: Candlelight, wool and warm wood: coziness against a dark winter evening.

nodes.title: Film noir
nodes.essence: Black and white, wet streets, venetian-blind shadows and a single streetlamp.

nodes.title: Technicolor
nodes.essence: Saturated, glowing color: ruby reds, emerald greens and creamy skin.

nodes.title: Kodachrome
nodes.essence: Deep reds, rich blues and dense shadows: slide film's sharp, saturated color.

nodes.title: Polaroid
nodes.essence: Soft warm color, milky shadows and a white frame: instant and slightly off.

nodes.title: Sepia photograph
nodes.essence: Warm browns from cream to umber: the color of old photographs.

nodes.title: Teal and orange
nodes.essence: Skin pushed orange, shadows pushed teal: the blockbuster color grade.

nodes.title: Bleach bypass
nodes.essence: Drained color, crushed blacks and silver highlights: gritty and metallic.

nodes.title: Neon noir
nodes.essence: Noir's night city, now in magenta and cyan neon reflected in rain.

nodes.title: Frutiger Aero
nodes.essence: Glossy glass, aqua water, blue skies and grass: tech optimism from the Vista years.

nodes.title: Y2K
nodes.essence: Chrome, frosted plastic, baby blue and silver: the future as seen around 2000.

nodes.title: McBling
nodes.essence: Hot pink velour, rhinestones and lip gloss: mid-2000s celebrity glam.

nodes.title: Vaporwave
nodes.essence: Pink-to-teal sunsets, marble busts and early-90s computer graphics, slowed down.

nodes.title: Synthwave
nodes.essence: Magenta sun over a cyan grid, a sports car and a purple night.

nodes.title: Seapunk
nodes.essence: Aqua hair, dolphins and iridescent teal: an ocean made of early web graphics.

nodes.title: Cyberpunk
nodes.essence: Rain, neon kanji and black chrome: high tech, low life.

nodes.title: Steampunk
nodes.essence: Brass, copper, leather and gears: a Victorian future that never happened.

nodes.title: Solarpunk
nodes.essence: Green roofs, sunlight and Art Nouveau curves: a hopeful, plant-filled future.

nodes.title: Liminal space
nodes.essence: Empty corridors, fluorescent yellow-beige and the hum of a place built for crowds.

nodes.title: Dreamcore
nodes.essence: Pastel skies, soft fields and doors to nowhere: the comfort and strangeness of a dream.

nodes.title: Weirdcore
nodes.essence: Low-res rooms, red-and-white warning text and colors that feel slightly wrong.

nodes.title: Webcore
nodes.essence: Default-blue links, beige towers, glitter GIFs and grey dialog boxes.

nodes.title: Kidcore
nodes.essence: Primary colors, crayons, rainbows and 1990s plastic toys.

nodes.title: Cottagecore
nodes.essence: Wildflowers, gingham and fresh bread: a soft, romantic idea of country life.

nodes.title: Fairycore
nodes.essence: Moss, mushrooms, gauzy wings and dappled light in a pastel forest.

nodes.title: Goblincore
nodes.essence: Mushrooms, moss, mud, frogs and shiny found things.

nodes.title: Whimsigoth
nodes.essence: Plum velvet, moons and stars, candles and burgundy: 1990s witchy.

nodes.title: Dark Academia
nodes.essence: Tweed, old libraries, candlelight and autumn: the romance of obsessive study.

nodes.title: Light Academia
nodes.essence: Cream linen, sunlit stone and pressed flowers: the hopeful side of studying.

nodes.title: Old money
nodes.essence: Navy, cream, camel and racing green: quiet, expensive and logo-free.

nodes.title: Coastal grandmother
nodes.essence: White linen, hydrangea blue, sand and a kitchen full of sun.

nodes.title: Clean girl
nodes.essence: Beige, cream and gold on glowing skin: minimal, polished, dewy.

nodes.title: Barbiecore
nodes.essence: Hot pink, head to toe, with more pink.

nodes.title: Millennial pink
nodes.essence: Dusty salmon-beige pink on everything from walls to suitcases.

nodes.title: Gorpcore
nodes.essence: Technical outdoor gear in safety orange, teal and olive, worn in the city.

nodes.title: Angelcore
nodes.essence: White robes, gold halos and cloud-soft pastels: heaven imagined as very, very clean.

nodes.title: Balletcore
nodes.essence: Leg warmers over tights, a wrap cardigan and the exact pink of a rehearsal studio.

nodes.title: Cabincore
nodes.essence: Knotty pine, a wood stove and a flannel blanket: cottagecore's colder, quieter cousin.

nodes.title: Cassette Futurism
nodes.essence: The future as 1979 pictured it: beige computer housings, chunky switches and a CRT's green glow.

nodes.title: Chaotic Academia
nodes.essence: Dark academia's desk after a long night: ink stains, loose papers and clashing patterns, worn proudly.

nodes.title: Science Academia
nodes.essence: A chalkboard full of equations, a worn lab coat and the deep blue of a late-night observatory.

nodes.title: Decora
nodes.essence: Every color at once: dozens of plastic clips, stickers and toys layered on top of each other.

nodes.title: Dieselpunk
nodes.essence: Art Deco curves welded to wartime machinery: brass goggles, rivets and smoke-stained industry.

nodes.title: Raygun Gothic
nodes.essence: Chrome fins and neon tubes imagining tomorrow from a 1940s pulp-magazine cover.

nodes.title: E-girl / E-boy
nodes.essence: Winged black eyeliner, a chain and a pink streak: 2000s emo and scene traded through a webcam.

nodes.title: Emo
nodes.essence: Black skinny jeans, a swept fringe and band-tour merch worn like armor.

nodes.title: Glitchcore
nodes.essence: Blown-out neon, VHS tearing and colors that fight each other on purpose.

nodes.title: Gothic Lolita
nodes.essence: A Victorian doll dressed for a funeral: black lace, platform boots and a parasol.

nodes.title: Health Goth
nodes.essence: All-black technical sportswear: a gym outfit styled for a nightclub.

nodes.title: Hypebeast
nodes.essence: A logo hoodie, limited sneakers and a drop you queued overnight for.

nodes.title: Indie Sleaze
nodes.essence: A flash-lit house party: smudged eyeliner, skinny jeans and a disposable-camera grain.

nodes.title: Mermaidcore
nodes.essence: Iridescent scales, sea glass and the exact blue-green of light through shallow water.

nodes.title: Normcore
nodes.essence: Dad jeans, a plain fleece and sneakers: looking deliberately unremarkable.

nodes.title: Pastel Goth
nodes.essence: A skull on a pastel sweater: goth's dark shapes recolored in candy pink and mint.

nodes.title: Princesscore
nodes.essence: A ball gown, a tiara and a palace garden lit for a storybook cover.

nodes.title: Riot Grrrl
nodes.essence: A slip dress over combat boots, marker-penned slogans and a scrawled zine stapled together.

nodes.title: Royalcore
nodes.essence: Velvet, ermine trim and a crown's worth of gold against a deep jewel-toned robe.

nodes.title: Scene
nodes.essence: Teased black-and-neon hair, striped arm warmers and a camera held above eye level.

nodes.title: Tenniscore
nodes.essence: A pleated white skirt, a striped cardigan and the clean green of a grass court.

nodes.title: Traumacore
nodes.essence: A pastel bedroom with a razor blade motif: childhood imagery turned uneasy.

nodes.title: VSCO girl
nodes.essence: A scrunchie, a metal straw and an Instax photo: 2019's wholesome, sun-faded cool.

nodes.title: Visual Kei
nodes.essence: Androgynous glam with towering teased hair, built for the stage rather than the street.

nodes.title: Witch House
nodes.essence: Blurred black-and-white with one sickly accent color: occult symbols rendered as a corrupted JPEG.

nodes.title: Witchcore
nodes.essence: Dried herbs on a windowsill, candle wax and a worn leather grimoire.

nodes.title: Afrofuturism
nodes.essence: Deep-space metallics layered over African textile pattern and color: a future rooted in a reclaimed past.

nodes.title: Cozy Gamer
nodes.essence: A farm-sim desktop, a soft blanket and a mug of tea beside the keyboard.

nodes.title: Cybergoth
nodes.essence: Goth's black armor wired up with UV-reactive neon and platform boots full of straps.

nodes.title: Nu-Goth
nodes.essence: Goth stripped to black, white and grey, with none of the lace or Victorian frills.

nodes.title: Atompunk
nodes.essence: Nuclear-glow optimism: chrome fins, ray guns and a trust in technology that World War II had not yet broken.

nodes.title: Cluttercore
nodes.essence: Every shelf full, every wall covered: a deliberate, colorful rebellion against minimalism.

nodes.title: Punk
nodes.essence: DIY music and street style built from torn clothes, safety pins and anti-establishment graphics.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Mod
nodes.essence: Sharp Italian-cut suits, parka coats and scooters, built around soul and R&B records.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Rave / acid house
nodes.essence: Warehouse parties built around acid house music, smiley-face graphics and neon rave-wear.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Hip-hop
nodes.essence: South Bronx DJ and street culture; its visual identity grew through graffiti, breakdance crews and gold jewelry.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Hippie counterculture
nodes.essence: Anti-war, communal youth culture: tie-dye, long hair and Eastern-influenced dress.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Disco
nodes.essence: Nightclub culture built around four-on-the-floor dance music, mirror balls and metallic fabric.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: New wave
nodes.essence: Angular, synth-driven pop culture that followed punk, with sharper, more graphic-design-literate style.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Skinhead
nodes.essence: Working-class London youth culture, originally close to mod and Jamaican rocksteady/ska, defined by cropped hair and work boots.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Rockabilly
nodes.essence: Early rock 'n' roll youth style: pompadours, leather jackets and pin-up print dresses.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Beatnik
nodes.essence: Beat Generation bohemia: black turtlenecks, berets and coffeehouse poetry readings.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Northern soul
nodes.essence: English dance-club scene built on American soul 45s, close to mod in dress and footwork.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Glam rock
nodes.essence: Theatrical androgyny: glitter, platform boots and metallic fabric, built around Bowie and T. Rex.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Goth
nodes.essence: Post-punk subculture built on dark romanticism: black clothing, pale makeup and Victorian-mourning references.
nodes.source: curated: documented social/design history (no painter corpus; see essence for the claim)

nodes.title: Arts and Crafts movement
nodes.essence: A reform movement against industrial manufacture: handmade furniture, textiles and botanical pattern design (William Morris).
